headline: PTC India, Coal India, and REC lead list of ten top dividend-yielding stocks
hook: Yields reaching up to 16.7 percent in 2026
summary: PTC India leads the list of ten prominent dividend stocks with a high yield of 16.7%, having declared two interim dividends and a final dividend in 2026. Other notable companies on the list include Coal India and REC, offering dividend yields of 6.3% and 6.1% respectively, based on an October 2026 analysis. For Indian retail investors, high-dividend stocks provide an alternate income stream alongside potential capital appreciation. Income-focused portfolios may benefit from evaluating these yields against broader fixed-income returns.
why_it_matters: Higher payout yields offer potential regular cash flow for income portfolios.
winners_losers: Dividend seekers gain / growth investors unaffected

headline: Ten Indian stocks offering the highest dividend yields right now
hook: Top dividend payers in Indian markets
summary: PTC India, Coal India, and GAIL are among the ten companies currently offering the highest dividend yields in the Indian market. The list also includes major information technology firms such as TCS and HCLTech. Dividend yield helps retail investors measure the cash return they receive relative to the stock price. This list highlights income-generating options for portfolios focused on regular payouts rather than pure growth.
why_it_matters: Identifies high dividend paying stocks for income-focused portfolios

headline: GTV Engineering, PH Capital, and PTC India approach record dates
hook: Final day for bonus and dividend eligibility
summary: GTV Engineering, PH Capital, and PTC India have set October 7 as the record date for upcoming corporate actions. Investors must purchase shares by Tuesday to qualify for these benefits. GTV Engineering is issuing a 2:1 bonus, while PH Capital is offering a 10:1 bonus. PTC India is also distributing dividends to eligible shareholders.
why_it_matters: Buy by Tuesday to qualify for bonus shares and dividends.
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / New buyers face dilution

headline: PTC India submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: PTC India Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Routine compliance filings such as AGM voting results do not alter the company's financial standing or share price directly. For an Indian retail investor, this is standard corporate governance reporting with no immediate impact on investment value.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact

headline: Small-cap dividend gems: Nine stocks offer yields of up to 16%
hook: High payouts among lesser known names
summary: Majestic Auto announced a dividend of ₹60 per share for FY 2025-26, translating to a 16.8% yield as shares rose 1.37% to ₹370 with a market cap of ₹384.71 crore. Indo Borax shares fell 3.23% while offering a ₹40 per share dividend yielding 7.9%. Other featured stocks in the list include Premco, PTC India, and Honda Power. These micro and small-cap yields offer alternative income streams for retail investors tracking high-dividend options.
why_it_matters: High dividend yields provide cash returns from small-cap holdings.
winners_losers: Dividend-focused retail investors gain / micro-cap volatility risks apply
